root_cause_analysis.symptom: Inside web <td>/<th> rendered by RenderTableBlockWeb/WebTableRow, bold/strike/link/code spans for cell text '**bold** ~~strike~~ [link](url) `code`' render as four stacked block-rows instead of a single inline line, at both desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Cycle 1 placed <RenderSpans/> (which returns a fragment of multiple sibling <Text> components) directly inside raw web <td>/<th> elements without a parent <Text> wrapper. On react-native-web, a <Text> whose immediate ancestor is not another <Text> defaults to display:flex with column flow (RNW falls back to flex when not in a Text-context), causing each formatted span to occupy its own block line.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: Working-tree HEAD (Cycle 1 in-progress edit; not yet committed). The plain-string baseline pre-Cycle-1 came from commit 0dd09cc3 ('fix: align table rendering with prod — empty first cell no longer drops last column'). Cycle 1 added the RenderSpans calls at MarkdownView.tsx:419-426 and :444-447 without parent <Text> wrappers — the working-tree diff captured in dev-report-20260507-055611.json.
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Cycle 1 dev mirrored the parser-level fix into the renderer by calling parseMarkdownSpans + RenderSpans for table cells, but did not also mirror the native path's parent <Text> wrapper that NativeTableColumn already used. The native path was correctly updated; the web path was not.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: RNW's Text layout requires a Text-parent context to keep sibling Text inline. Without it, sibling Texts default to block-like flex display, breaking inline visual flow of formatted spans inside a single cell.

ac_new_1.verbatim_from_close_report: Inside web <td> and <th> elements rendered by RenderTableBlockWeb / WebTableRow in MarkdownView.tsx, the output of RenderSpans MUST flow inline. Specifically: Bold 'bold', struck 'strike', linked 'link', and code-styled 'code' in cell text '**bold** ~~strike~~ [link](https://example.com) `code`' MUST render on a single visual line at desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844 (subject to natural text wrapping when the cell content exceeds the cell width). Each span MUST share the same getBoundingClientRect().y (within ±2px tolerance) when the cell width is large enough to contain them on one line. The QA verification recipe MUST measure x-coordinate flow (e.g. Array.from(cell.querySelectorAll('[data-fontWeight]')).map(el => el.getBoundingClientRect()) and assert y values are equal within tolerance), not just computed CSS properties.
